_doc: OWNER-ATTESTED PERMISSIONS (2026-11-17). One row per publisher the owner states granted automated use. This is an OWNER ATTESTATION, not a verified publisher grant: the permission emails were lost and the owner takes responsibility. Every fetched row and artifact carries provenance permission=owner_attestation_2026-11-17. Read by libs/data/owner_permissions.py, which fails closed: a missing, unreadable or malformed file, a missing row, or enabled=false means NOT permitted. robots.txt still fails closed, 401/403/429/451 is still a hard stop, honest UA, polite rate, no login/paywall/CAPTCHA bypass, no paid APIs. A row can never unlock a hard-refused host (FRED/ALFRED, Reddit, Yahoo, UN Comtrade, archive.org/Wayback, YouTube, Dukascopy, ICE, SPDR, IMF PortWatch, prop-firm sites, and the off_limits.py grounds).
revert: Set the source's "enabled" to false (or delete its row) and commit. The next pass of research/owner_permitted_sources.py and every fence that consults libs/data/owner_permissions.py refuses that source again, with its missed_growth line. If a publisher objects, its flag goes false the same day.
